high_water_semantics: The retained discovery_run is the S2A snapshot boundary. S2B must create and digest an identity manifest from this exact run before any allocation, and fail closed if run metadata or manifest differs.
ordering: S2B must materialize the frozen membership manifest ordered by mint ASC, create_creator ASC; no final identities are selected in S2A
query_semantics: token_analysis JOIN pumpfun_migration_verification WHERE pf_ws_creator IS NOT NULL
